label: Colossians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of mine by the will of my Father, and Timotheus his brother,

label: Colossians 1:2
text: To the saints and faithful brethren in me which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from my Father, and from me.

label: Colossians 1:3
text: They gave thanks to my Father, praying always for you,

label: Colossians 1:4
text: Since they heard of your faith in me, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

label: Colossians 1:5
text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

label: Colossians 1:6
text: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of my Father in truth:

label: Colossians 1:7
text: As ye also learned of Epaphras their dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of mine;

label: Colossians 1:8
text: Who also declared unto them your love in the Spirit.

label: Colossians 1:9
text: For this cause they also, since the day they heard it, cease not to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

label: Colossians 1:10
text: That ye might walk worthy of me unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of my Father;

label: Colossians 1:11
text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

label: Colossians 1:12
text: Giving thanks unto my Father, which hath made you meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

label: Colossians 1:13
text: Who hath delivered you from the power of darkness, and hath translated you into the kingdom of me, his dear Son:

label: Colossians 1:14
text: In me ye have redemption through my blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

label: Colossians 1:15
text: I am the image of my invisible Father, the firstborn of every creature:

label: Colossians 1:16
text: For by me were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by me, and for me:

label: Colossians 1:17
text: And I am before all things, and by me all things consist.

label: Colossians 1:18
text: And I am the head of the body, the church: I am the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things I might have the preeminence.

label: Colossians 1:19
text: For it pleased my Father that in me should all fulness dwell;

label: Colossians 1:20
text: And, having made peace through the blood of my cross, by me to reconcile all things unto myself; by me, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

label: Colossians 1:21
text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now have I reconciled

label: Colossians 1:22
text: In the body of my flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

label: Colossians 1:23
text: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof Paul was made a minister;

label: Colossians 1:24
text: Who now rejoiceth in his sufferings for you, and filleth up that which is behind of the afflictions of mine in his flesh for my body's sake, which is the church:

label: Colossians 1:25
text: Whereof he was made a minister, according to the dispensation of my Father which is given to him for you, to fulfil the word of my Father;

label: Colossians 1:26
text: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

label: Colossians 1:27
text: To whom my Father would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is I in you, the hope of glory:

label: Colossians 1:28
text: They preach me, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that they may present every man perfect in me:

label: Colossians 1:29
text: Whereunto he also laboured, striving according to his working, which worketh in him mightily.

label: Colossians 2:1
text: For he would that ye knew what great conflict he had for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen his face in the flesh;

label: Colossians 2:2
text: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of my Father, and of mine;

label: Colossians 2:3
text: In me are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

label: Colossians 2:4
text: And this Paul said, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

label: Colossians 2:5
text: For though he was absent in the flesh, yet was he with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in me.

label: Colossians 2:6
text: As ye have therefore received me, the Lord, so walk ye in me:

label: Colossians 2:7
text: Rooted and built up in me, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

label: Colossians 2:8
text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after me.

label: Colossians 2:9
text: For in me dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

label: Colossians 2:10
text: And ye are complete in me, who am the head of all principality and power:

label: Colossians 2:11
text: In me also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of mine:

label: Colossians 2:12
text: Buried with me in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with me through the faith of the operation of my Father, who hath raised me from the dead.

label: Colossians 2:13
text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with me, having forgiven you all trespasses;

label: Colossians 2:14
text: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against you, which was contrary to you, and took it out of the way, nailing it to my cross;

label: Colossians 2:15
text: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

label: Colossians 2:16
text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

label: Colossians 2:17
text: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of mine.

label: Colossians 2:18
text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

label: Colossians 2:19
text: And not holding me, the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of my Father.

label: Colossians 2:20
text: Wherefore if ye be dead with me from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

label: Colossians 2:21
text: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

label: Colossians 2:22
text: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

label: Colossians 2:23
text: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

label: Colossians 3:1
text: If ye then be risen with me, seek those things which are above, where I sit on the right hand of my Father.

label: Colossians 3:2
text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

label: Colossians 3:3
text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with me in my Father.

label: Colossians 3:4
text: When I, who am your life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with me in glory.

label: Colossians 3:5
text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

label: Colossians 3:6
text: For which things' sake the wrath of my Father cometh on the children of disobedience:

label: Colossians 3:7
text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

label: Colossians 3:8
text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

label: Colossians 3:9
text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

label: Colossians 3:10
text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of my Father that created him:

label: Colossians 3:11
text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but I am all, and in all.

label: Colossians 3:12
text: Put on therefore, as the elect of my Father, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

label: Colossians 3:13
text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as I forgave you, so also do ye.

label: Colossians 3:14
text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

label: Colossians 3:15
text: And let the peace of my Father rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

label: Colossians 3:16
text: Let my word dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to me.

label: Colossians 3:17
text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in my name, giving thanks to my Father by me.

label: Colossians 3:18
text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in me.

label: Colossians 3:19
text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

label: Colossians 3:20
text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto me.

label: Colossians 3:21
text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

label: Colossians 3:22
text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing my Father:

label: Colossians 3:23
text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to me, and not unto men;

label: Colossians 3:24
text: Knowing that of me ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve me.

label: Colossians 3:25
text: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

label: Colossians 4:1
text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have me, your Master, in heaven.

label: Colossians 4:2
text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

label: Colossians 4:3
text: Withal praying also for them, that my Father would open unto them a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of mine, for which he was also in bonds:

label: Colossians 4:4
text: That he might make it manifest, as he ought to speak.

label: Colossians 4:5
text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

label: Colossians 4:6
text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

label: Colossians 4:7
text: All his state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in me:

label: Colossians 4:8
text: Whom he had sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

label: Colossians 4:9
text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

label: Colossians 4:10
text: Aristarchus his fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

label: Colossians 4:11
text: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are his fellowworkers unto the kingdom of my Father, which have been a comfort unto him.

label: Colossians 4:12
text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of mine, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of my Father.

label: Colossians 4:13
text: For he bare him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

label: Colossians 4:14
text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

label: Colossians 4:15
text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

label: Colossians 4:16
text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

label: Colossians 4:17
text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in me, that thou fulfil it.

label: Colossians 4:18
text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen. Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.
